approaches.title: In-place right-to-left increment
approaches.summary: Scan digits from right to left, increment the first digit below 9, and zero trailing 9s. If every digit was 9, prepend 1.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Tracks carry explicitly while scanning backward; on overflow, builds a new vector with a leading 1.

revisions.commitBody:
- appending is O(n) anyways so just insert
- insert also gives a chance to reuse the current allocation
- cleaner early escape
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Returns immediately after incrementing a digit below 9; otherwise, prepends 1 after zeroing all digits.
